vessel_basis: Standardized T-class trial; the vessel class in the clip is not confirmed.

mapping.note: The only main face is a provisional standardized proxy for the captioned landing.

tide.method: First six-minute sample of the cached day with speed >=0.5 m/s and direction within 45 degrees of the documented phase; unspecified captions use local midnight without asserting a phase.
tide.note: A representative simulation day, not the recording date or observed current speed.

wind.note: 2.5 kn is the midpoint of the caption range 2–3 kn; null means unreported and the standardized trial uses still air.

driver: HarborJourneyControls unchanged, including its initial 55 m astern departure phase. Standardized bow-on proxy, not recovered helm orders or a recreation of the filmed path.
fender_note: No per-landing stiffness, damping, friction or compression measurements support a distinct surface yet. Existing surfaces remain unchanged.
